All 9 tests now pass (`node --test`). I fixed two bugs in the source and left the tests alone.

1. **`src/bill.js`, off-by-one in `splitBill`.** The check `i <= leftover` handed an extra cent to one payer too many. `splitBill(900, 3)` returned `[301, 300, 300]`, which no longer added up to the total. It is now `i < leftover`.
2. **`src/duration.js`, loose parsing in `parseDuration`.** The regex matched anywhere in the string, so `"10m and change"` was accepted as 10 minutes. It now also requires the whole string to be one or more `<digits><h|m|s>` groups, and throws `SyntaxError` otherwise.

I only ran `node --test`.
